findings.title: Top-level topicUnsubscribe route will not resolve the nested unsubscribe template
findings.body: The route is declared as a top-level route named `topicUnsubscribe`, so Ember's default template name is `topic-unsubscribe` (or `topicUnsubscribe`), not `topic/unsubscribe`. The added template is at `app/assets/javascripts/discourse/templates/topic/unsubscribe.hbs`, which would match a nested `topic.unsubscribe` route. Since the route does not override `renderTemplate`, the unsubscribe page will not render its client-side content. Move the template to `templates/topic-unsubscribe.hbs` or declare `unsubscribe` as a nested route under `topic`.

findings.title: unsubscribe crashes when the current user has no TopicUser record
findings.body: `TopicUser.find_by` returns nil if the current user has never interacted with this topic, which is possible when the URL is visited directly or from a stale email. The next line calls `tu.notification_level`, raising `NoMethodError` and returning a 500 before any notification level is changed. Use `TopicUser.find_or_initialize_by(...)` or `TopicUser.change` so a missing record is created instead of crashing.

findings.title: Per-topic unsubscribe changes state via GET without CSRF or token
findings.body: The new `unsubscribe` action is a GET route that modifies `TopicUser.notification_level`. A logged-in user's browser can be made to request `/t/<slug>/<id>/unsubscribe` from a third-party page, and because the action is not protected by CSRF or a token, the change will be applied. An attacker can mute or downgrade notification settings for arbitrary topics for a victim. Use a signed/one-time token in the email link or require a CSRF-protected POST.

findings.title: unsubscribe_link interpolation now requires unsubscribe_url but MessageBuilder has no fallback
findings.body: `server.en.yml` changed `unsubscribe_link` to interpolate `%{unsubscribe_url}`. `MessageBuilder` only populates that key if the caller passed `unsubscribe_url` in opts. Any existing `Email::MessageBuilder` use with `add_unsubscribe_link: true` but no `unsubscribe_url` will now get an I18n missing interpolation error in both `html_part` (line 67) and `body` (line 90). Since this is a shared builder, provide a safe default/guard or update all callers and fail explicitly before building the mail.

findings.title: Unsubscribe copy promises full stop but controller only lowers to regular
findings.body: The string says "You will stop receiving notifications for {{title}}." However the controller sets a watching/tracking user to `regular` on the first click, and `regular` still permits notifications such as replies and mentions. Users may believe they are fully unsubscribed while still receiving some notifications. Either set `muted` for a true unsubscribe or change the copy to describe changing notification state.

findings.title: No tests for new unsubscribe action, route, or per-topic email link
findings.body: The only test change supplies `unsubscribe_url` to an existing builder example but does not assert that the per-topic unsubscribe link appears in the body. There are no controller/request specs for `TopicsController#unsubscribe` (authentication, slug redirects, missing TopicUser, notification-level transitions) or for the Ember route/template. The new behavior can break without detection.
